Nadia, Gideon landed on **280 seats** for Vantorre Group in his July 1 update in #strategic-pod.

He first wrote 300, then corrected it a few minutes later. The 300 came from a staging tab that included sandbox logins from the May rollout. The 280 is the number of active seats on the production roster as of July 1. Ruth acknowledged the corrected figure in the thread.
